setup_search_keys: ↑/↓ Choose · Type to search · Enter Accept · Esc Back
ui_password_keys: Tab show/hide · Enter Accept · Esc Cancel
source: Path to the reviewed new checkout
local_tls: Turn local HTTPS on or off
name: IP or hostname (without http:// or port)
error: The operation did not finish. Check the indicated private log.
pending: An operation is pending. Keep maintenance enabled and use Recover.
restore: Restore SQL and application (user files excluded)
form_cancel_hint: Return without applying the form changes.
checks_warning: Some checks reported problems. Review the results.
dashboard_keys: ↑/↓ Select · ←/→ Column · Tab Next · Enter Open · Esc Exit
view_keys: ↑/↓ Scroll · PgUp/PgDn Page · Home/End · Enter/Esc Back
desc_setup: Pending step: verify after creating the administrator in the browser.
desc_updates: Patches, next major, image and components; nothing is applied without confirmation.
desc_diagnose: System, free space, Nextcloud state and last check.
desc_self_update: Install a reviewed copy of the manager.
desc_backups: Create, verify, restore or delete backups.
desc_maintenance: Services, cron, certificates and backups; optional daily schedule.
desc_recover: Resume or recover an interrupted operation.
desc_domains: Trusted addresses, HTTPS, IP and ports.
desc_install: Prepare Nextcloud to complete its installation in the browser.
install_intro: Install locally first. Add a public domain afterwards.
environment_help: The first installation uses LAN or loopback. Add the public domain afterwards.
cancelled: Cancelled. No subsequent steps were applied.
restore_word: Current user files stay in place. Old SQL may describe a different file state. Type RESTORE to confirm; Esc cancels.
confirm_edit_keys: Type RESTORE · Enter Confirm · Esc Cancel
confirm_files: Confirm that user files have not changed since the selected backup. Restoring old SQL with changed files can leave inconsistent references.
confirm_database: This Nextcloud version requires another MariaDB LTS. SQL will be backed up and the migration rehearsed in a new volume.
confirm_major: The next major version will be verified. SQL and application will be backed up and the upgrade rehearsed.
confirm_update: The target will be checked before updating. User documents remain in their storage.
confirm_install: Create Nextcloud for local access. Create the administrator from its web page afterwards.
install_confirm_help: Install now starts installation. Cancel or Esc returns to the form.
install_form_intro: Edit any fields you need. Install Nextcloud opens the final confirmation.
install_submit_help: Continue to the final confirmation; you can still return and edit the values.
install_cancelled: Installation cancelled. You can edit the values or leave the form.
confirm_docker: Install Docker Engine and Compose from the official repository.
backup_scope: Includes SQL, application and certificates. Excludes user documents, versions and trash.
confirm_settings: Apply the reviewed settings and verify access.
confirm_resume: Resume the pending operation from its recovery point.
confirm_schedule: Schedule daily checks. Updates require a manual action.
confirmation_help: Use ↑/↓ and Enter to confirm. Esc returns without starting this action.
form_intro: Select a field to edit. Review the summary before applying.
review_help: Check the values. Select a field to correct it, or confirm the action.
invalid_email: Enter a valid email or leave it empty.
initial_binding: Complete the first installation on a private LAN IP; on a VPS or with a public IP use 127.0.0.1 and an SSH tunnel.
field_help_bind: Choose the IP where the proxy will listen.
field_help_address: IP or hostname for opening Nextcloud, without protocol or port.
field_help_http_port: HTTP port from 1 to 65535; different from the HTTPS port.
field_help_https_port: HTTPS port from 1 to 65535; different from the HTTP port.
field_help_storage_root: Absolute host folder for persistent data.
field_help_name: IP or domain without http://, https://, path or port.
field_help_email: Optional certificate account contact. This is not the Nextcloud administrator's email.
version_help: Latest and previous officially maintained majors. You can choose another from the form.
support_eol: OBSOLETE: Nextcloud %s is end of life
support_cached: Could not refresh the calendar. Using the last saved official maintenance dates.
ports_existing: An existing panel was detected. Review ports before continuing.
error_help: Read the message and the private log. Enter or Esc returns to the menu.
web_setup_help: Open this address and create your Nextcloud credentials. Then choose “Check web installation”.
setup_repairs_deferred: The database exceeds 64 MiB. Indices and MIME types are deferred to planned maintenance.
setup_integrity_warning: Integrity warnings remain. Check “List of invalid files” in Nextcloud.
domains_help_add_local: Allow another LAN IP or hostname to access Nextcloud.
domains_help_add_direct: Use a domain pointing to this server. Requires DNS and inbound TCP 80/443.
domains_help_add_tunnel: Add the hostname of an existing cloudflared tunnel. Local access is retained.
domains_help_remove: Remove an allowed address. Nextcloud files are retained.
domains_help_primary: Nextcloud uses this URL to generate links and check its configuration.
domains_help_local_tls: Enable or disable a local certificate. Devices must trust Caddy's CA.
domains_help_ca: Export the root certificate to trust local HTTPS on your devices.
domains_help_network: Adjust the proxy listening IP and HTTP/HTTPS ports.
tunnel_first_primary: The first tunnel domain becomes Nextcloud's primary address. Local access is retained.
tunnel_primary_saved: Domain saved as primary for links and checks. Local access is retained.
tunnel_help: Install and configure cloudflared manually. Preserve the public hostname and forward /.well-known/acme-challenge/ to the proxy.
direct_help: Point DNS to this server and allow TCP 80/443 to reach the proxy.
ca_help: Import this public CA on clients using local HTTPS.
backup_list_help: Select a backup to see its details. Enter opens; Esc returns.
backup_unverified: Descriptive metadata. Integrity is checked when verifying or restoring.
updates_help: An isolated rehearsal uses real SQL and no user documents.
no_updates: No version is available for this action.
database_required: The LTS branch changes only when required by the next Nextcloud version.
no_database_path: No maintained LTS supports both versions; the migration needs separate review.
components_help: Each component is checked and updated separately. MariaDB keeps its LTS branch.
maintenance_help: Checks services, cron, certificates, backups and versions. It does not apply updates automatically.
self_update_help: Path to a downloaded and reviewed copy of the repository.
stop_help: Nextcloud, cron, proxy, Redis and MariaDB for this installation will stop.
exit_confirm_hint: Press Enter or Esc again to exit.
back_help: Return to the previous menu without changes.
delete_help: The file is removed from disk. Other backups and Nextcloud data are unchanged.
export_help: Saves the current Docker images to backups/docker-images.tar for offline installs. Replaces the previous export.
updates_none: Nextcloud and its components are up to date.
major_needs_patch: The major upgrade becomes available after the latest patch of the current series.
schedule_unavailable: Daily scheduling requires systemd; you can still check manually.
logs_help: Shows the latest 200 lines of the service. Esc returns to this list.
vps_loopback_set: VPS: listening IP and local address set to 127.0.0.1 (connect through an SSH tunnel).
field_help_publish: Yes: listen on every IP (0.0.0.0) with ports 80/443 so the certificate is issued directly.
